title: Movie

Fast Atlanta
Follow four best friends who grew up sharing the love of street racing and car culture in Atlanta, Georgia.

description: To avoid losing her home to foreclosure, single mother Angela Logan (Kimberly Elise) tries to bake and sell 100 apple cakes in 10 days.

description: A White House butler (Forest Whitaker) has a front-row seat to history through three decades and seven presidential administrations, including those of Eisenhower (Robin Williams), Kennedy (James Marsden) and Nixon (John Cusack).

description: A nurse (Pam Grier) takes revenge on a drug ring for the slaying of her undercover-officer boyfriend.

description: Four Boston friends (Allen Payne, Aaron D. Spears) become big-time drug dealers but face the wrath of another kingpin.

title: Traffik
description: A couple and their two friends embark on a weekend getaway to an isolated estate in the mountains. They soon find themselves in a fight for their lives when members of a violent biker gang show up to protect their secrets from the outside world.

title: Beyond the Lights
description: A troubled star and an aspiring politician fall deeply in love, but those around the couple urge them to put their careers ahead of romance.

title: Precious
description: Pregnant and abused, a Harlem teen (Gabourey Sidibe) enrolls in an alternative school in an attempt to bring value to her life.

title: A Murder of Crows
description: A lawyer (Cuba Gooding Jr.) must prove he is innocent of murder after passing a dead man's tale of intrigue off as his own.

title: Black Cobra
description: A man is forced to smuggle and sell illegal black diamonds to pay for his father's pardon back home in South Africa.

title: Fifty Shades of Black
description: In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," wealthy entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) introduces a young woman (Kali Hawk) to his kinky world of S&M.

title: Dear White People
description: A campus culture war between blacks and whites at a predominantly white school comes to a head when the staff of a humor magazine stages an offensive Halloween party.

title: Meet the Blacks
description: A Chicago man (Mike Epps) moves his family to Beverly Hills, Calif., on the same day when all crime becomes legal for a 12-hour period.
